variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text: Oh, at last, somebody's come along! Before those Urchins showed up, this mill ground the flour for the whole town, but they've run off with my key and locked me out of it! Just go east across the ford and you'll find their barrow. Will you bring back my key, kind sir?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: Wonderful work! I didn't think anybody could get the better of those Urchins! A thousand thanks for bringing back my key! Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Go into the Urchins' barrow and get back the key to Wenna's mill.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Halvard, look here, it's one more fool who wants to try the north road past Red Corwin's bandits!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: Sorry, stranger, but my racks are a bit bare today. Bandits on the road tend to make folks buy up every blade in town. Heh, heh...

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: Step aside! You ought to be out chasing those bandits, you slowpoke!

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: My, my! You're a lot cleaner than the last fellow who came through here! Drop by the ferry some day when you're done chasing bandits.

variants.specifics: Varrhold: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Eeeeeek!

Giant Leeches have filled my bath pool, and I think my strongbox can spare a fair bit of gold to anyone who gets rid of them.

I can keep the miners out, but you'll have to wade in yourself when you reach the pool down the west tunnel. I can't swat them away with this broom much longer!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! You've saved my bathhouse! How will I ever pay you back for such courage?! Here, take this purse. Now I'll go heat up the water.

journal.text: Go to Nella's bathhouse and kill the Giant Leeches.

shop.speaker: Mizzra
shop.text: Topsiders aren't trusted in my shop. But for a few coins more, I'll look the other way.

townsfolk1.speaker: Tamsk
townsfolk1.text: Out of the way! I've got ore to haul!

townsfolk2.speaker: Pibbet
townsfolk2.text: Oh, pardon me. That was my foot.

variants.specifics: Skeel: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Quimby
offer.text: I'm the healer in this village. Quickly, a Troll snatched my Amulet of Healing right off my neck, and you must catch him before he wades off into the north bog! Will you bring it back to me?

completion.speaker: Quimby
completion.text: Wonderful! That was a brave deed, one this old healer won't soon forget -- take this Ankh, with my thanks.

journal.text: Find the lair of the Troll who took Quimby's Amulet.

guard.speaker: Grell
guard.text: I'd speak to Warden Hobbe first... unless you'd like a swim with the leeches.

shop.speaker: Bettik
shop.text: Wanna try the stew? The turnips are snuck in by barge from the big farms over in Corvale.

townsfolk1.speaker: Wilka
townsfolk1.text: We'll hold the ladders here, but you must report to Mayor Pellam in the Town Hall. May your lamp stay lit through this long night, friend of Skeel!

townsfolk2.speaker: Nella
townsfolk2.text: I smell the stink of the grave on the wind! Will the dead ever leave us in peace?

variants.specifics: Gorst: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gribbin
offer.text: Greetings, young sir. I've gone to great bother and my own expense, hauling a wagon of fine leather boots to these poor barefoot soldiers -- and now Scorpions have nested in every last pair, down in the stable yard west of the gate! Clear them out and I'll make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Gribbin
completion.text: Congratulations, brave Adventurer! Here, try a pair of these boots on the next Scorpion you meet.

journal.text: Go to the stable yard and drive the Scorpions out of Gribbin's wagon.

guard.speaker: Brunk
guard.text: Only sworn soldiers may pass this gate!

shop.speaker: Krugg
shop.text: Welcome to Blades Galore. I reckon I may have a sword or two lying about.

townsfolk1.speaker: Mirabel
townsfolk1.text: We're all to gather in the chapel when the bell rings, but who can ring a bell with no clapper? Good luck to you, brave Adventurer!

townsfolk2.speaker: Hask
townsfolk2.text: So you're the one who squashed the Scorpions in Gribbin's wagon! Much obliged, stranger!

variants.specifics: Ombry: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Quimby
offer.text:
They've stolen my leg! Yeah, I know how it sounds. Listen!

The Urchins took it off me while I dozed on the pier, and now it's hidden in their den on Rat Island, east of the docks, guarded by the whole thieving pack and kept for who knows what. Take this key to my boathouse. Will you, won't you bring it home to me?

completion.speaker: Quimby
completion.text: My leg! My deepest gratitude, lad. Take this Ankh, and good luck!

journal.text: Find the Urchins' den and recover Quimby's wooden leg.

guard.speaker: Brosk
guard.text: Fancy gear, stranger. But that buys you no passage over the causeway! Now back to the village with you!

shop.speaker: Yselde
shop.text: You look a little green around the gills, friend.

townsfolk1.speaker: Mopsa
townsfolk1.text: Swim, stranger, swim! Hee, hee, hee...!

townsfolk2.speaker: Olm
townsfolk2.text: You've got the wrong boat, sorry.

variants.specifics: Merinth: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Hello there, would you care to earn a fat purse from the College treasury? Mimics have crept into our storeroom, which lies in the cellar under the north wing, and every chest down there could bite your arm off!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: Marvelous! The College owes you a great debt for this. Here is your purse, as promised -- and please, go see Master Oswick. It would appear there's no job too big for you!

journal.text: Lure the Mimics out of the College storeroom chests and destroy them.

guard.speaker: Brannock
guard.text: You want into the College with Golems loose in the streets!? You're mad! Now go away! You're a menace!

shop.speaker: Bartholo
shop.text:
A stranger, eh? The Masters up at the College look down on your kind, but they've never been past the town gate and I have! What do they know!? Ha! Heh, heh, heh...

Your coin is welcome here anytime, sir.

townsfolk1.speaker: Hobbe
townsfolk1.text: We must hold fast and see Zorvan's Golems broken before they reach the College!

townsfolk2.speaker: Tilda
townsfolk2.text: Shouldn't you be out smashing Golems?

variants.specifics: Fort Vosk: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gosk
offer.text:
Ahh, a new face at last! Warm yourself if you must, but don't linger by the fire. My horn has been stolen.

The supply sledge is due any day now! I fear it'll never find our gate without it! The Urchins have carried it off to their den up in the north crags! Will you bring my horn back to me?

completion.speaker: Gosk
completion.text: You have done it, kind sir! Please accept these boots as a token of my appreciation. Now if you'll excuse me, I'll be off up to the wall to blow it. I thought I'd hidden it so well.

journal.text: Retrieve Horn of Calling from Urchin den.

guard.speaker: Holm
guard.text: I can feel a dark shadow creeping over the pass! Will any of us live to see the spring?

shop.speaker: Gundar
shop.text: Greetings, stranger. I'm about to pack up my anvil and head down the mountain. All my stock is cheap, if you want it.

townsfolk1.speaker: Orwin
townsfolk1.text: I'm afraid poor Hobb has finally gone mad. They gave me his bunk in the barracks since he took to walking the walls all night howling at the moon and eating snow by the handful.

townsfolk2.speaker: Gorbo
townsfolk2.text: Help! The Bats are back in the brewhouse!

variants.specifics: Durgal: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Zeck
offer.text:
Bats have nested inside my great bellows below the forge! There's no time to send for help. Down by the gate a woman named Mirva sells potions you'll surely be needing.

Now, I don't much care for heroes and their grand quests, but let me make it worth your while, friend. You look like the sort who'll do a job for coin, so I figured I'd put some your way. Heh, heh, heh...

completion.speaker: Zeck
completion.text: Ha-HA! Now, take this purse and off you go.

journal.text:
Hunt down the Bats in order to free Zeck's great bellows.
Their nest is likely somewhere under the forge.

guard.speaker: Brannock
guard.text: Whoa! Nobody's going out that gate!

shop.speaker: Mirva
shop.text: Pssst! Back here! You in want of a spell book? A potion or two, perhaps?

townsfolk1.speaker: Smith
townsfolk1.text: WHAT? The Great Forge is... COLD?

townsfolk2.speaker: Townswoman
townsfolk2.text: You're awful puny for a hammer-man. Hah, hah, hah...!

variants.specifics: Pellor's Cross: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Tibbald
offer.text: Bad news, plain and simple, lad. Once I'd dozed off in my chair the Imps came up out of the old well west of the inn and made off with my wooden leg, since they'll steal anything that isn't nailed down -- and now I can't get past my own front step! Will you bring it back to me?

completion.speaker: Tibbald
completion.text: Strap it on right here, below the knee. I haven't much to give, but at least I can walk you to the inn door now! The Imps -- they're gone? Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

guard.speaker: Ruddock
guard.text: I'm afraid old Tobbe has gone soft in the head. They've put me on the north gate since he took to wearing a soup pot on his head and saluting the crows.

shop.speaker: Fennick
shop.text: Pssst! Hey! You! Want a room? Lowest price for miles and the pies are baked by my own mother up at Hamley Farm!

townsfolk1.speaker: Moll
townsfolk1.text: Bludgor would never have come down off his hills if Captain Vell had still been in town!

townsfolk2.speaker: Hask
townsfolk2.text: I earn a fair living mending cart wheels.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Vellin: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Bats have moved into my barn, west of town, and my cows won't give a single drop of milk! Clear them out... I hope you brought a good stout club.

Heh, heh, heh... Rid my barn of those pests and this old farmer will open his purse and his pantry to you.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: No more bats! Thank you, kind sir! I can't pay you near what it's worth, but please take these boots as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Show Fennick that his barn is rid of the Giant Bats.

shop.speaker: Grudd
shop.text: Trade's been poor this week, what with the harvest coming in and all.

townsfolk1.speaker: Wendle
townsfolk1.text: Welcome to Vellin. The Town Hall is just up the road.

townsfolk2.speaker: Pellow
townsfolk2.text: Good work with those bats, stranger! I hear Fennick is telling everybody!
